issues.where: left limb and upper-left limb (crops B, D, G)
issues.what: the atmosphere glow in -a is a wide, soft, warm-white haze that bleeds into space. In -b it has become a thin, hard, cyan-blue rim line with almost no outer falloff
issues.fix: widen the limb glow to match -a, soften its outer falloff, and shift the hue from blue toward neutral or warm white

issues.where: background sky, left and right of the planet (crops B, G, I)
issues.what: the Milky Way in -a is dense and structured, with dark dust lanes, running roughly vertically near both sides of the planet. In -b it is a fainter, smeared horizontal band (low on the right), and the starfield is replaced by evenly spread, larger, brighter dots
issues.fix: restore the original Milky Way placement, density and dust-lane structure, and bring star size and count back down to the fine, varied field in -a

issues.where: center valley, below the right mesa wall (about x740 y330; crop A)
issues.what: a new bright white blob with a curving light streak, like a smear or foreign object, has appeared in the canyon floor haze. It is not in -a
issues.fix: remove the artifact so the valley matches the soft, dim haze of -a

issues.what: -a has a faint Milky Way band and a dense field of fine stars. -b has lost the Milky Way and shows sparser, larger, evenly spread stars
issues.fix: bring back the faint Milky Way at top center and use the finer, denser star texture from -a

issues.where: bottom edge of the planet, below the moon
issues.what: a scatter of small reddish speckles or particles near the lower limb that are not in -a
